“The fool, like all of us, starts out knowing nothing. But he takes a leap of faith, and that’s what starts his journey.”

With 15 minutes left on death row, a condemned man agrees to a tarot reading with a visiting reverend. What follows is a tense psychological duel where hidden motives surface and neither man is who he seems.

Written, directed by, and starring Ernest Anemone alongside Max MacKenzie, THE LAST FOOL is a sharp, claustrophobic 20-minute existential thriller praised for its “provocative frame composition and chest-beating sound design” (Film Threat).

Watch the full award-winning short free on YouTube: https://youtu.be/go2F1tFvOwU
